const p="*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Camera-guided controller for the single OpenDishwasher episode.
+
+Usage: python /app/output/gen.py observe TAG
+       python /app/output/gen.py move TAG N --by VALUE [--bx VALUE ...]
+       python /app/output/gen.py joints TAG N Q1 Q2 Q3 Q4 Q5 Q6 Q7 [--grip VALUE]
+
+Each invocation connects to the same live episode, never resets it, and saves
+camera observations and robot proprioception under /app/runs/TAG.
+"""
+import argparse
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+CAMERAS = ["robot0_agentview_center", "robot0_agentview_left",
+           "robot0_agentview_right", "robot0_eye_in_hand"]
+
+
+def main():
+    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    p.add_argument("verb", choices=["observe", "move", "joints"])
+    p.add_argument("tag")
+    p.add_argument("n", nargs="?", type=int, default=0)
+    p.add_argument("q", nargs="*", type=float)
+    p.add_argument("--bx", type=float, default=0)
+    p.add_argument("--by", type=float, default=0)
+    p.add_argument("--yaw", type=float, default=0)
+    p.add_argument("--torso", type=float, default=0)
+    p.add_argument("--grip", type=float, default=None)
+    args = p.parse_args()
+
+    r = Robot()
+    before = r.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, video="none", include_depth=True)
+    layout = before.meta["proprio"]["layout"]
+    state = dict(zip(layout, before.meta["proprio"]["now"]))
+    if args.verb == "observe":
+        result = before
+    else:
+        q = [state[f"robot0_joint{i}_pos"] for i in range(1, 8)]
+        if args.verb == "joints":
+            if len(args.q) != 7:
+                p.error("joints requires exactly seven targets")
+            q = args.q
+        grip = state["cmd_grip"] if args.grip is None else args.grip
+        action = np.array(q + [grip, args.bx, args.by, args.yaw,
+                               args.torso, 1 if args.verb == "move" else -1], dtype=float)
+        result = r.submit("joint_position", np.repeat(action[None], args.n, axis=0),
+                          cameras=CAMERAS, video="none", include_depth=True,
+                          note=f"{args.verb} {args.tag}")
+    path = Path("/app/runs") / args.tag
+    result.save(str(path))
+    m = result.meta
+    s = dict(zip(m["proprio"]["layout"], m["proprio"]["now"]))
+    print(json.dumps({"tag": args.tag, "time_left_s": m["time_left_s"],
+                      "steps": m["control_steps"], "done": m["done"],
+                      "base": [s[f"mobilebase0_joint_mobile_{v}_pos"] for v in ("forward", "side", "yaw")],
+                      "torso": s["mobilebase0_joint_torso_height_pos"],
+                      "joints": [s[f"robot0_joint{i}_pos"] for i in range(1, 8)],
+                      "eef": [s[f"eef_right_{v}"] for v in "xyz"],
+                      "grip": [s["gripper0_right_finger_joint1_pos"], s["gripper0_right_finger_joint2_pos"]]}, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(p));

from scipy.optimize import lsq_linear
p=json.load(open('/app/runs/050p_probe.json'));q=np.array(p[0]['q']);x=np.array(p[0]['eef']);J=np.column_stack([(np.array(o['eef'])-x)/(np.array(o['q'])[i]-q[i]) for i,o in enumerate(p[1:])]);print('q',q.round(3),'x',x,'J',J.round(3));
for d in [[.04,0,-.04],[.05,0,-.05]]:
 A=np.vstack([J,np.eye(7)*.03]);b=np.r_[d,np.zeros(7)];lo=np.array([-1,-1,-1,-1,-1,-1,-1]);hi=np.array([1,1,1,1,1,1,1]);hi[1]=1.74-q[1];lo[5]=-1.5;hi[5]=3.7-q[5];res=lsq_linear(A,b,bounds=(lo,hi));print(d,'dq',res.x.round(3),'target',(q+res.x).round(3),'pred',(J@res.x).round(3))
